card: Updates the RPC help text for backupwallet to specify that destination paths must include a filename. Previously, the documentation implied passing a directory path alone was valid, which causes wallet backups to fail with RPC error -4 under SQLite. This fixes misleading documentation for wallet RPC callers.
evidence: PR description: "help backupwallet lists a directory as a valid destination. Passing an existing directory returns RPC error -4."
Commit 476caddd0e: "SQLite opens the destination as a file. Passing a directory fails, even though the RPC help advertises support for it."
problem: The `backupwallet` RPC help text suggests an existing directory is an acceptable destination argument. Because SQLite treats the destination as a file path, passing a directory causes the call to fail with RPC error -4 ("Wallet backup failed!").

risk.why: Touches only RPC help string descriptions without altering any executable wallet or RPC logic.

summary: Updates the RPC help text for `backupwallet` to clarify that the destination path must specify a filename. It corrects documentation that previously implied a directory path alone was valid.
